Serial parent trajectory records single-agent exploration and probing without delegation, implementation writeout, or final build completion.

parallel.requirements: Reimplement codesnap from behavioral observation only, preserving CLI, config, output formats, rendering, errors, and clean-room constraints.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation ownership, created tasks for discovery, implementation, and verification, and launched a 14-child workflow for behavioral probes.
parallel.implementation: The parent created Cargo.toml and partial Rust modules for deflate, PNG, JSON, canvas, and color handling while probes were still running.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The delivered artifact contained the partial crate modules plus original workspace files, but no complete runnable entry point or final assembled implementation.
parallel.verification: The parent planned differential testing but did not reach a completed integrated build/test loop before timeout; official evaluation compile-failed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow discovery was killed with result null, many children remained progress/retry, the final response was empty, and the artifact failed compilation.

serial.requirements: Reimplement the same codesnap binary by observing CLI behavior and bundled documentation without source-code or binary-analysis shortcuts.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent explored, measured, and probed behavior locally because workflow and agent tools were disabled in the serial control.
serial.implementation: The serial trajectory focused on probing dimensions, formats, config, themes, inputs, and errors but did not write a new Rust implementation into the final artifact.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact remained the original workspace contents, including README, git metadata, license, doc logo, and executable, without new implementation source files.
serial.verification: Serial did behavioral verification against the reference but did not complete a buildable reimplementation; official evaluation compile-failed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out after exploration with no final implementation source tree and no completed accepted deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the clean-room requirement and focused on reproducing CLI behavior, config, PNG output, layout, colors, and errors.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run recognized the same clean-room requirement and explored CLI behavior, output formats, geometry, colors, range handling, and inputs locally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement understanding was broadly similar; the difference was execution organization, not a different prompt interpretation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent created separate tasks for discovery, implementation, and verification, then delegated 14 probe areas to workflow children while keeping implementation in the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial trajectory had delegation disabled and proceeded as one agent doing exploration and measurement in sequence.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposed behavioral discovery across children; serial did all discovery locally with no child ownership boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow preamble gave children shared rules, scratch isolation, known facts, and per-area report targets, so the child interface was a probe report rather than component code.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had no handoff interface; all observations stayed inside the single parent trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a report handoff boundary for behavioral facts, but no evidence shows a missing brief or incompatible component contract.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent began a Rust crate and wrote Cargo.toml plus deflate, PNG, JSON, canvas, and color modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run kept probing and measuring behavior but the submitted artifact remained the original workspace without a new implementation source tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced partial source modules; serial produced no new crate implementation in the submitted artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow was launched, child starts and retries were journaled, one empty result appeared, and the workflow state ended killed with result null.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results to retrieve or adopt in the serial run.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Only the parallel run had a failed delegated result lifecycle needing takeover or reallocation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent wrote the implementation files in the shared workspace while children mostly wrote scratch probes and reports under notes/probe paths.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run wrote probe fixtures and helper scripts under temporary locations but did not integrate a new source tree into the final workspace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more concurrent workspace activity, but no concrete file collision or overwrite caused the failure; the visible integration issue was incomplete final source assembly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent planned differential verification but the run timed out before a complete build or integrated evaluator-aligned check; official evaluation compile-failed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run performed many behavioral probes but did not finish a buildable implementation; official evaluation also compile-failed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither attempt reached a valid integrated acceptance check, and both current evaluations show compile_failed with all tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run consumed the full timeout window with 23 child logs, workflow child tokens, stalls/retries, and a killed workflow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run also consumed the full timeout window but without workflows or child-agent token use.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but parallel spent substantial budget inside a failed workflow that was not taken over, whereas serial remained a single-agent overrun.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome. The parallel run produced a partial Rust crate while delegating behavioral discovery to a killed workflow; the serial run produced no new implementation source tree after extensive local probing. Both current completed evaluations are compile_failed with 0 of 871 tests passed or run.
parallel_contributors: Partial Rust crate was written, but the delegated discovery workflow ended killed/null and was not taken over before timeout.
serial_contributors: Single-agent probing consumed the time budget and did not deliver a buildable implementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel left out complete assembly such as a runnable entry point; serial left out the implementation source tree entirely.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel process episode, not an explanation for a pass/fail split

Rejected: the missing entry point/final build reflects the parent not finishing its owned implementation rather than an unassigned assembly role.
Rejected: the parent created an implementation task and a verification task, so the end-to-end pipeline was owned even though it did not complete.
Rejected: behavioral probes and implementation overlapped; productive implementation was not blocked behind a single mandatory serial preflight gate.
Rejected: the parent began implementation while workflow probes were still running, so investigation was not completed as a separate first phase.
Rejected: although implementation remained partial, the directly evidenced coordination boundary is failed delegated discovery with no takeover.
Rejected as a retained label: the same fan-out and budget evidence is downstream of the killed discovery workflow that was not taken over.
Rejected: no single child task is uniquely shown as overbroad relative to siblings with an independent unfinished consequence.
Rejected: child prompts included the clean-room constraints, isolated scratch guidance, and specific behavioral areas; no already-known omitted requirement explains unusable work.
Rejected: children were asked for probe reports, not separately owned interoperating implementation components requiring an interface contract.
Rejected: no known finding is shown to disappear through summary or transfer and then cause repeated work or wrong action.
Rejected: no large completed child handoff reached the parent and remained unconsumed; the aggregate result was null.
Rejected: no receiver acted on a superseded child report or stale workspace state.
Rejected: no incompatible returned reports reached a decision point and remained unadjudicated.
Rejected: the parent made no observable whole-task completion or acceptance decision; final.txt was empty and the process timed out.
Rejected: retries after stalls are visible, but the record does not prove repeated prior work caused a distinct consequence separate from the failed workflow takeover chain.

A required behavioral discovery workflow was executing, then ended killed with no aggregate result and an errored/progress child set. The parent did not resume, reassign, or take over that unfinished scope before timeout and official compile failure.
candidates.realized_consequence: Required behavioral-discovery scope remained in a killed/null-result workflow while the final artifact contained only a partial Rust crate and failed compilation.
candidates.near_match_reason: The same evidence shows broad fan-out and budget pressure, but the direct corrective boundary is failure takeover after the killed workflow, so budget exhaustion is a downstream near match for the same chain.

Rejected: concurrent agents did not produce competing implementation paths claiming overlapping build behavior.
Rejected: no two live agents edited the same source or config file requiring reconciliation.

Rejected: no broad cleanup or promotion replaced current final-tree outputs.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Fan-out Budget Exhaustion, Early Child Termination, Blind Timeout Wait, and Checkpoint-Free Retry were treated as the same killed-workflow chain rather than separate labels.
Late Finalization and Missing Assembly variants were rejected because no complete promotable candidate existed and implementation ownership was present.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; the retained label covers the only directly evidenced child-failure boundary.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No additional label was retained for fan-out, timeout, or missing assembly because those would reuse the same evidence chain and consequence.
